artworks.title: Reflection
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a seated woman wearing a large coat and skirt. She is seated with her body angled to the side, head turned slightly towards the viewer. The woman has delicate facial features, with her hair covered by a fluffy hat. Her hands are resting in her lap as she sits on a wide chair. She is not wearing any visible jewelry or holding any objects. The background features simple vertical lines resembling a plain interior wall, creating a minimalist setting.

artworks.title: Chinese Embassy Delegation at Niagara Falls
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Scott Nathan and Laura DeBonis
artworks.description: A group of men is depicted on a wooden bridge-like structure. They are dressed in formal clothing, including suits and traditional garments, complete with hats. Some are leaning against the railing. The men have clean-shaven faces and mustaches, with varying short hairstyles. The background includes a stone tower resembling a lighthouse on the right side, trees, a clear sky, and mist possibly from a waterfall in the distance.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a woman with a composed expression seated and slightly turned to her left, looking at the viewer. She has dark eyes, wears a cap partially covering her hair, pulled back neatly. The woman is dressed in a dark, long-sleeved gown with a white lace collar and cuffs, and a long chain necklace. She rests one arm on an ornate or upholstered armrest and has her other hand on her lap. The backdrop is neutral, and the portrait is housed in a dark, elaborately carved frame.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Girl
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The image is an old photograph showing a full-body view of a young child seated on a chair. The child is facing the camera directly with both feet flat on the floor. Their facial features include a serene expression, light-colored eyes, and neatly combed light hair. The child is wearing a dress with a white bodice and a plaid skirt adorned with dark horizontal stripes, coupled with socks and dark shoes. In one hand, the child is holding a small bunch of flowers. The background appears plain, with a simple gradient indicating a wall and floor, and the photograph is encased in an ornate, dark frame with intricate floral and scroll designs.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Family
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from W. Bruce and Delaney H. Lundberg
artworks.description: The image shows a family of four, displaying their upper bodies as they sit together. In the center of the frame is a man seated, wearing a dark suit and bow tie, with short hair neatly combed. To his right is a young girl, also seated, wearing a dress and holding a doll. She has her hair styled and appears to be sitting on a small stool. To the man's left, a baby is seated on the lap of a woman. The woman is wearing a long-sleeved dress with a high collar and her hair is styled back with a center part. The baby is dressed in a gown and has short hair. The family poses against a plain, softly lit backdrop. The photo is enclosed in an ornate frame, featuring shades of red and an inner gold border.

artworks.title: Yoked and Muzzled - Marriage
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund

artworks.title: Seven Man Gun Crew
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from W. Bruce and Delaney H. Lundberg
artworks.description: The image shows six men positioned around a large cannon, visible from head to toe, standing on a grassy field. Four of the men, at the ends and on both sides of the cannon, have either an arm or leg resting on the cannon, and the two men in the middle stand directly behind the cannon. Their faces vary, with one man having a full beard and the others having different degrees of facial hair ranging from clean-shaven to mustaches. All the men are wearing caps and military attire. One man holds a small bugle or a similar wind instrument. In the background are open, flat grounds with conical tents pitched in the distance, suggesting a camp setting.

artworks.title: 1st Louisiana Guards
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from W. Bruce and Delaney H. Lundberg
artworks.description: Six men in dark military uniforms are depicted in the image. The front row shows three seated men holding swords. The back row displays three standing men with serious expressions. The men have varying facial hair and hairstyles. They are all dressed in dark military uniforms with white collars and shoulder epaulets, holding swords. Some wear belts, indicating military rank. The background shows a painted backdrop with trees and an American flag. The setting appears to be indoors based on the patterned rug.

artworks.title: Seven Shots made by President Lincoln with Spencer rifle
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Ronald M. Costell, M.D. and the Estate of Marsha E. Swiss
artworks.description: The image shows round, dark holes on a textured wooden surface. The holes are scattered randomly and there are lines and scratches on the wood.

artworks.title: Lincoln Funeral Train in Harrisburg, Pennsylvania
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from W. Bruce and Delaney H. Lundberg

artworks.title: The New Capitol, Columbia, South Carolina
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Diana and Mallory Walker

artworks.title: Trestle Bridge at Whiteside
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Diana and Mallory Walker
artworks.description: The image depicts a sepia-toned photograph of a large wooden trestle bridge extending across the scene. The sky appears clear with some brightness. A river flows near us, bordered by rocks and logs, with vegetation and trees visible in the background. To the right, a wooden structure runs parallel to the river, partially in shadow. A solitary figure sits on a log close to us beside the water. The overall tone of the photograph is earthy and monochromatic, lending a historic and timeless quality to the composition.

artworks.title: Rebel Works in front of Atlanta, Georgia (No. 3)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from W. Bruce and Delaney H. Lundberg
artworks.description: The image shows an artillery position with a cannon behind a barricade of earth and sandbags. In the background, there is a line of trees with a lone taller tree slightly right of center. Beyond the cannon, there is an encampment with rows of tents arranged neatly. The landscape has a historical photograph style with monochromatic tones, giving a dusty atmosphere. The color palette is sepia-like browns and grays.

artworks.title: Lookout Mountain, Georgia
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Diana and Mallory Walker
artworks.description: The photograph depicts a landscape captured from an elevated vantage point. The view shows undulating hills meeting the sky in the distance. A rocky cliff with sparse trees and foliage is visible on the right side. A winding river cuts through the terrain below, reflecting the sky. The land beyond the cliff is dotted with trees and fields, leading to a more densely vegetated area in the background. The image is monochromatic with sepia tones.

artworks.title: Pass in the Raccoon Range, Whiteside No. 1
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Diana and Mallory Walker

artworks.title: General W.S. Hancock and Staff
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Diana and Mallory Walker
artworks.description: The image depicts four men in military uniforms reminiscent of the 19th century. Three men are standing while one is seated beside a large tree. The seated man has a large mustache and beard, and a distinctive hat with a decorative band. He wears a uniform with multiple military insignia. The man to his left has combed hair, a mustache, and a beard, he leans against the tree holding a hat and resting one arm on a sword or cane. The man on the seated man's right has a beard and stands with one hand in his pocket. The man on the far right has a full beard and mustache, leaning against the tree. All are dressed in dark, formal jackets with metal buttons and sashes, indicating their officer status. The background shows dense foliage, a canvas tent behind the group, and scattered leaves on the ground.

artworks.title: Fort Sumter, Charleston, South Carolina
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from W. Bruce and Delaney H. Lundberg
artworks.description: The image displays a ground-level view of a large open space bordered by a substantial brick structure with multiple arched openings. At the top of the building, a flagpole with a waving flag is visible. Several cannons are positioned along the edge. Close by, a group of men stands on a rubble-strewn surface, engaging in various tasks, with scattered materials and large artillery pieces nearby. The structure shows signs of wear, with damaged or incomplete brickwork. The color palette consists of sepia tones, typical of vintage photographs.

artworks.title: Union Army Re-laying Tracks Torn Up by Confederates in Civil War
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Ronald M. Costell, M.D. and the Estate of Marsha E. Swiss
artworks.description: This is a photograph of several people working on a railway track in a wooded area. The scene shows individuals engaged in laborious activities, surrounded by trees and bushes. The ground is littered with debris and metal parts, suggesting construction work. Various tools are visible, and some individuals seem to be supervising or assisting with the task. The image captures a moment of manual labor in a rugged environment.

artworks.title: The Second Inauguration of Abraham Lincoln, Washington, DC
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Ronald M. Costell, M.D. and the Estate of Marsha E. Swiss
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a large crowd gathered at a formal event in front of a building with classical architecture. The image captures a historic scene with a densely packed assembly of individuals spread across different levels of an outdoor platform. The background shows a building with tall columns and ornate architectural details. A large flag is draped near the building's facade. The individuals are dressed in formal attire. The elevated platform in the center is crowded with people who appear to be observing or participating in the event, while the foreground is filled with an audience looking towards the platform.

artworks.title: Fort Garry
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Ronald M. Costell, M.D. and the Estate of Marsha E. Swiss
artworks.description: The image shows a view from a slightly elevated position looking across land towards a fort or settlement enclosed by a wooden fence. The horizon line is positioned about two-thirds up from the bottom of the image, primarily showing the structures of the fort with a few buildings visible beyond the fence. The image is in sepia tones, giving a vintage monochrome effect, emphasizing light and dark contrasts. The land in the foreground is uneven with trenches or ruts leading down to the fort in the distance.

artworks.title: Enslaved People at Volusia, Residence of Felix Richards
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Ronald M. Costell, M.D. and the Estate of Marsha E. Swiss
artworks.description: The image shows a group of individuals gathered outdoors around washing equipment. In the center, a woman stands with one hand on a table covered with a cloth. To the left, a seated woman has her arm around a small child. A young boy stands beside them. In front of the standing woman, another child sits next to a basket. On the right, three children sit on the ground, one inside a wooden tub. The background features bare trees, a hillside, and structures in the distance, suggesting a rural setting.

artworks.title: No. 289.—Sculpture of North Wing of Capitol, Washington, DC
artworks.creditLine: Alfred H. Moses and Fern M. Schad Fund

artworks.title: Bull Run Bridge Repaired
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from W. Bruce and Delaney H. Lundberg
artworks.description: The image shows a wooden railway bridge crossing over a body of water. Men are on the railway tracks near a stone abutment, with the wooden bridge structure visible. The railway extends into the distance, curving through a landscape with hills, trees, and a cloudy sky. The scene has a sepia tone color palette, giving it a historical appearance. The details in the image capture the textures of the landscape, water, and wooden bridge.
